question: Does provider historical_volume add causal entry-onset information beyond the same price-and-clock HGB model?

interpretation.primary_object: incremental historical-volume information for entry-onset probabilities and alert timing
interpretation.volume_meaning: provider OHLCV volume attached to each historical five-minute bar; not exchange-wide consolidated volume, aggressor-side volume, order flow, quote count, tick count, or order-book depth

periods.train_rule: an anchor may train a monthly model only when its complete future path ends strictly before the score month begins

sources.provider_price_basis: provider OHLC exactly as stored; no independent corporate-action adjustment

universe.training_and_metric_weighting: raw weight exactly 1 / (represented sessions for the symbol * rows in the symbol-session), then normalized to mean one

target_blind_volume_coverage.missing_handling: current-missing indicator plus fold-training median imputation of derived continuous features; no future value, backward fill, or forward fill

decision_and_path.reference_price: exact next five-minute open at t+1
decision_and_path.scale: median exact true range in basis points over the last min(12, available) contiguous completed bars ending at t-1

classes.0: no_entry: no hit by horizon or intrabar ambiguous first touch

decision_and_path.gap_open_rule: an open at or beyond exactly one barrier establishes that side first

price_features.source: exact frozen 40-feature raw-OHLC entry-onset V1 surface

historical_volume_feature_definitions.base_transform: lv_t = log1p(historical_volume_t) when finite and nonnegative, else missing
historical_volume_feature_definitions.exact_group: symbol, regular-session date, and contiguous five-minute segment; all rolling windows reset at a gap
historical_volume_feature_definitions.historical_volume_missing_current: 1 when historical_volume_t is missing or nonfinite, else 0
historical_volume_feature_definitions.historical_volume_log_change_1: lv_t - lv_(t-1), requiring both exact bars
historical_volume_feature_definitions.historical_volume_log_ratio_prior_3: lv_t minus mean(lv) of exact bars t-3 through t-1, requiring all 3
historical_volume_feature_definitions.historical_volume_log_ratio_prior_6: lv_t minus mean(lv) of exact bars t-6 through t-1, requiring all 6
historical_volume_feature_definitions.historical_volume_log_ratio_prior_12: lv_t minus mean(lv) of exact bars t-12 through t-1, requiring all 12
historical_volume_feature_definitions.historical_volume_log_ratio_segment_prio: lv_t minus expanding mean(lv) of all earlier bars in the exact segment, requiring at least 3 prior bars
historical_volume_feature_definitions.historical_volume_recent_3_minus_older_1: mean(lv) over t-2 through t minus mean(lv) over t-14 through t-3, requiring all 15 exact bars
historical_volume_feature_definitions.historical_volume_prior_12_log_std: population standard deviation of lv over t-12 through t-1, requiring all 12
historical_volume_feature_definitions.historical_volume_availability_12: finite lv count over exact bars t-11 through t divided by 12; early segment bars remain fractions below one
historical_volume_feature_definitions.historical_volume_range_interaction_6: historical_volume_log_ratio_prior_6 multiplied by causal price log_range_ratio_6
historical_volume_feature_definitions.historical_volume_body_interaction_6: historical_volume_log_ratio_prior_6 multiplied by causal price signed_body_fraction; a price-volume interaction, not signed or aggressor-side volume

algorithms.name: price_historical_volume_hgb
algorithms.features: the same 40 price-and-clock features plus the 11 historical_volume features in frozen order

hypotheses.question: Do current-versus-prior historical-volume shocks improve first-passage class probabilities beyond price?
hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: separate unusually active bars from visually similar price bars
hypotheses.safety_risk: must not be called order flow or market-wide participation
hypotheses.stop_condition: reject if the full volume model does not improve both log loss and Brier stably versus price_hgb

hypotheses.question: Do segment-relative level, short-versus-older acceleration, and prior variability add information?
hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: distinguish a one-bar spike from sustained activity
hypotheses.safety_risk: session clock and symbol scale can confound raw volume; no raw volume level is included
hypotheses.stop_condition: leave descriptive if local volume sensitivity is not recurrent across at least five months and fifteen stocks

hypotheses.question: Does relative historical volume change the meaning of bar range or body direction?
hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: test whether downside-expansion reversal alerts differ when the completed bar is unusually active
hypotheses.safety_risk: the signed-body interaction is not buy/sell volume
hypotheses.stop_condition: reject as a broad entry sign if matched price-only onset evidence fails frozen path gates

hypotheses.question: Is any apparent improvement stable across months and unchanged-prediction stock deletions rather than driven by missingness or stock identity?
hypotheses.safety_risk: the inherited 22-stock cohort is not universe-independent
hypotheses.stop_condition: reject if fewer than 18 of 22 stock deletions improve both probability losses at any horizon

thresholds_and_onsets.source: immediately prior monthly OOF probability ledger
thresholds_and_onsets.weighted_quantile_method: left-continuous inverse weighted empirical CDF using stable value order

matched_price_controls.purpose: incremental historical-volume test beyond the price-only HGB surface
matched_price_controls.matching: same symbol, score month, and horizon; prefer same 15-minute bin, same price-history availability bucket, and different session; deterministic relaxations to 30-minute bin then local pool
matched_price_controls.rank: control price-only probability for the imposed side descending, then anchor_id ascending

bootstrap.method: paired non-circular overlapping five-session moving-block bootstrap

retention_gates.pass_interpretation: retain only as a 2024 post-outcome development hypothesis for a genuinely new prospective shadow test
retention_gates.failure_interpretation: historical_volume did not add a broad stable entry-onset signal under this frozen representation

reason_extraction.method: for each candidate onset, replace all 11 volume features by their fold-training medians and measure the change in chosen-versus-opposite HGB probability margin
reason_extraction.label: local historical-volume group sensitivity; not additive, causal attribution, order flow, or participation confirmation
reason_extraction.post_outcome_feature_or_signature_enrich: exploratory only and cannot rescue the frozen hypotheses
